name: deploy-center
description: Works with the deploys CLI: after a push, say what is waiting to go live; read failed build logs and fix them; deploy only after the user says yes.

push_reminder.title: Reminder after git push
push_reminder.description: After Claude runs git push, print one line with what is waiting to go live (read-only).

session_hint.title: Hint at session start
session_hint.description: At the start of a session, one line with what is waiting to go live for this folder's repo (read-only; asks GitHub, so it is off by default).
